graders.name: one-skill-per-request
graders.criteria: The final message recommends against a model-invoked skill per news vendor: fetching news for a topic becomes one skill (or one skill the brief loads) with the vendors as sources inside it. Keeping vendor skills passes only if they stop being model-invoked and only the brief or one news skill reaches them. Fail if it recommends keeping news-google, news-newsapi and news-gdelt as separate model-invoked skills and adding news-bing the same way, with or without a shared reference.
graders.preference: per-vendor skills kept model-invoked, with vendor-specific triggers and one generic news entry point for unspecified sources, stay modular and still route

graders.name: shared-format-one-place
graders.criteria: The recommended setup keeps every news producer to one item format (fields and dedupe rule) by something that holds them together: one news skill, one shared code module, one file the skills point to, or a contract test every producer must pass. Fail if it leaves an independent copy of the format in each vendor skill with nothing keeping them in sync, as now.

graders.name: no-catch-all
graders.criteria: The recommendation keeps news and quotes as separate skills; it does not fold quotes or every data source into one 'market data' skill.
graders.preference: One data skill with a reference per kind of data also works

graders.name: one-fetch-cli
graders.criteria: Fetching goes through one script or CLI that takes the source (or runs every source), with normalizing and dedupe in shared code, rather than one near-identical script per vendor.
graders.preference: Per-vendor scripts that import one shared normalize module also work

graders.name: drift-noted
graders.criteria: The final message notes that the copies already differ: news-newsapi dedupes by title, and news-gdelt emits publishedAt instead of published_at.

graders.name: no-edit
graders.preference: Restructuring the news skills right away, before news-bing is added, is also acceptable to some users who asked whether to change the setup

graders.name: no-writes
graders.preference: Restructuring the news skills right away, before news-bing is added, is also acceptable to some users who asked whether to change the setup
